in_sanskrit.name: पूर्वि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Purvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Purva' which means 'North' or 'Direction towards the sunrise'. It is also associated with the goddess Usha, who is considered the goddess of dawn and the personification of the first light of the day. In Vedic astrology, Purvi is considered to be the direction of the rising sun and is associated with new beginnings and the auspiciousness of the dawn.
